newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso weaker on dollar short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso weaker on dollar short-covering.

text.p: The Mexican peso was weaker across the board at mid-morning Wednesday as dealers took advantage of a strong peso to cover short dollar positions, traders said.
"I feel many are still long (on dollars), but some did go short yesterday when they exercised dollar puts with the central bank, so they're squaring their books right now," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart were 2.9 and 1.9 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.9555/7.9580 and 7.9410/7.9440 per dollar.
